scope: Documented product facts relevant to travel checking and frequently accessed savings. Null means the supplied evidence did not establish a value.

checking_options.name: Purple Account
caveats: ATM operator surcharges and network fees are separate from the foreign transaction fee.
Rebates apply to eligible ATM operator fees after posting and are capped at $30 monthly.
A separate disclosure says the $2.50 out-of-network ATM fee applies per withdrawal and provides no international exception. Do not represent the $0 foreign ATM withdrawal fee as eliminating this fee.
Avoid optional dynamic currency conversion if the customer prefers local-currency billing; merchant/processor conversion is separate.

checking_options.name: Green Account (checking)
caveats: No foreign-transaction-fee benefit is established by the supplied Green checking disclosure.

savings_options.name: Silver Plus Account
caveats: The 3.0% Tier 1 rate applies below $15,000; 4.5% Tier 2 applies at or above $15,000.
A 0.025% relationship bonus is described only when unspecified relationship criteria are met; do not include it absent confirmation.
The supplied eligible-pairings list does not list Green checking plus Silver Plus savings.

savings_options.name: Silver Account
caveats: The Green checking plus Silver savings pairing is documented as eligible for a +0.25% checking-linked boost.
A 0.025% relationship bonus requires eligibility that has not been established.
A Platinum Rewards Card can increase withdrawals to 15, but card ownership/linkage must be confirmed before using that allowance.

savings_options.name: Gold Account
caveats: Gold Rewards Card holders have a reduced $5,000 minimum balance and a +0.025% APY bonus, but card ownership and linkage must be confirmed.
Do not infer a below-minimum fee because none was supplied.

general_linking_policy: Only documented checking/savings pairings receive a linked APY boost. Where several checking boosts apply, only the highest checking boost applies; checking boosts do not stack with each other. Other bonuses need separately established eligibility.
